do_not_use_when: Event generation from a UFO: use model-events.
A whole-parent reinterpretation: use analyze with its inputs.

examples.phrase: Run a bounded model-probe operation on a supplied model artifact.

use_when: A bounded supplied-artifact or fixed phase-space operation such as UFO, EFT, LLP, efficiency-map or detector-response checks.
The operation is named by a registered domain and runs on supplied artifacts.
